title: Ye Kaun Karbala Ko Kaaba Bana Raha Hai
body:
Tauheed Ko Yeh Kiska Sajda Bacha Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayat Hai Rasan Main Bikre Hue Hain Paaray (x2)
Naizay Pey Aaj Quriyan, Qur’an Sunaraha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Beton Ko Daike Sadqa Aur Behnon Ki Ridaain (x2)
Rozay Azal Kiya Jo Waada Nibha Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiskay Galay Kay Bosay Letay Thay Khud Muhammad (x2)
Zalim Usi Galay Pay Khanjar Chala Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal Main Istarha Say Bikra Yateem Qasim (x2)
Chun Chun Kay Tukray Maula Laasha Bana Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aagosh Main Jo Maa Ki Sota Tha Pyaara Asghar (x2)
Aagosh Main Lahed Ki Baba Sula Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujkho Tamachay Maray Kanon Say Durr Hain Cheenay (x2)
Ab Has Kay Mujhko Zalim Tera Sir Dikha Raha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Tak Rahe Gi Duniya Roshan Rahe Gi Shahid (x2)
Shabeer Jo Lahoo Say Sham`may Jala Raha Hai
